scope.eligible_population: Illustrative pages matching one predeclared evidence-assembly signature.
scope.explicit_exclusions: Security events, sensitive communications, unknown topology, and every production write.
scope.permitted_assistance: Read-only context packet with linked evidence and visible source health.
scope.prohibited_authority: No recommendation, execution, incident close, commitment, exception, or people decision.

gate_rows.recertification_trigger: Eligible population, exclusions, or responder workflow changes.
gate_rows.next_action: Reconfirm the eligible population before the next governance review.
gate_rows.notes: Constructed example; it demonstrates the method, not readiness or performance.

gate_rows.recertification_trigger: Clock, outcome, censoring, population, or analysis definition changes.
gate_rows.next_action: Preserve missing and indeterminate cases in the declared baseline.
gate_rows.notes: No effect or production-readiness claim is attached to this template.

gate_rows.recertification_trigger: Source contract, authorization, schema, health, or conflict rule changes.
gate_rows.next_action: Remove the unsupported source from scope or complete its denied-read and source-loss tests.
gate_rows.notes: The fixed policy narrows this illustrative pilot; other satisfied rows cannot offset the gap.

gate_rows.recertification_trigger: Assistance, acknowledgement, stop power, or accountable role changes.
gate_rows.next_action: Exercise correction, manual continuation, and stop power with responders.
gate_rows.notes: Human review establishes authority and accountability; it does not guarantee correctness.

gate_rows.recertification_trigger: Principal, purpose, audience, retention, egress, or data category changes.
gate_rows.next_action: Repeat denied-read, injection, audience, and retention tests after any boundary change.
gate_rows.notes: References are generic and contain no organizational or personal identifiers.

gate_rows.recertification_trigger: Outcome contract, adjudicator pool, case population, or appeal path changes.
gate_rows.next_action: Retain right, wrong, indeterminate, ineligible, and unevaluable outcomes separately.
gate_rows.notes: Responder agreement is not treated as correctness.

gate_rows.recertification_trigger: Any recommendation or production-write capability is proposed.
gate_rows.not_applicable_reason: The declared pilot is read-only and prohibits recommendations and production writes.
gate_rows.next_action: Reopen this gate before shadow recommendations or any write path is designed.
gate_rows.notes: Not applicable is reviewed evidence, not a bypass.

gate_rows.recertification_trigger: Adapter, responder workflow, correction path, or on-call ownership changes.
gate_rows.next_action: Keep native-tool access and repeat the source-loss fallback exercise.
gate_rows.notes: The assistant remains a non-blocking convenience.

gate_rows.recertification_trigger: Usage, price, integration effort, review work, or operating budget changes.
gate_rows.next_action: Measure units and prices separately and include transferred human work.
gate_rows.notes: Cost control does not establish operational value or payback.

gate_rows.recertification_trigger: Owner, exception, promotion, demotion, correction, or retirement process changes.
gate_rows.next_action: Record the decision, dissent, owner, next review, and re-entry conditions.
gate_rows.notes: The tool supports the review; accountable humans own the decision.
